given: a stock row whose canonical location is already its own column
when: the migration runs and splits out batch and serial
then: the row's location value is unchanged and is not overwritten from the code's leading segment

independence.rationale: other ACs concern the new batch/serial columns and the old code; this adds the distinct outcome that the pre-existing location column is left canonical and untouched

architectural_notes: Infra layer: a non-regression contract on the canonical location column. The backfill transform only writes batch_number and serial_number (segments 2 and 3) and never touches location, keeping the (sku, location) uniqueness key (PI from F1 / R3) intact. Owner module: the Alembic migration data step. Data-integrity concern: preserve the canonical addressing key. Verified by a real-branch test asserting location values are byte-for-byte unchanged after the migration and are not overwritten from the code's leading segment.
